usage: 液體 is a noun and refers to any substance that flows and takes the shape of its container.
You can use 液體 to talk about water, oil, juice, or any liquid substance in science or everyday contexts.
When describing properties of substances, 液體 contrasts with 固體 (solid) and 氣體 (gas).
In sentences, 液體 usually serves as the subject or object.
液體 can be combined with verbs like 流 (flow), 飲 (drink), or 攪拌 (stir).
